senses.definition: n.f. crown, wreath;—abs. ע׳ Ez 21:31; Ct 3:11; cstr. עֲטֶרֶת 2 S 12:30 + 17 times; pl. עֲטָרוֹת Zc 6:11; Jb 31:36, עֲטָרֹת Zc 6:14;—crown:

of idol-image (Milcom, 𝔊 We Klo Dr Kit Löhr HPS) 2 S 12:30 = 1 Ch 20:2; golden, ע׳ פָּז ψ 21:4; ע׳ תִּפְאַרְתְּכֶם of king and queen, Je 13:18 the crown of your splendour; cf. Ez 21:31; wedding-crown Ct 3:11.

ע׳ זָהָב Est 8:15 (of Mordecai); of silver and gold Zc 6:11, 14; ע׳ תִּפְאֶרֶת crown of splendour, on personif. Jerus. Ez 16:12 (in allegory), Jerus. and Samaria 23:42; ע׳ as appos. (= sim.) Jb 31:36.

fig. of honour, etc., Jb 19:9 (‖ כְּבוֹדִי) La 5:16; אֵשֶׁת חַיִל ע׳ בַּעְלָהּ Pr 12:4, cf. 14:24; 17:6; ע׳ תִּפְאֶרֶת 16:31 (of שֵׂיבָה); gift of wisdom 4:9; fig. of Jerus. Is 62:3 (‖ צְנִיף מְלוּכָה), cf. ע׳ גֵאוּת 28:1, 3 fig. of Samaria; fig. of י׳, ע׳ צְבִי v 5 (‖ צְפִירַת תִּפְאָרָה).
